title: Audit and close pre-release deprecated asset cleanup lifecycle
outOfScope: Do not rewrite historical archive evidence, delete assets, change release behavior, or retroactively invent a PR for the direct-main historical cleanup.

sources.reason: Historical cleanup content and its missing PR lifecycle.

riskAssessment.reason: Historical content exists on main but its direct-main delivery has no PR lifecycle; audit must distinguish current asset truth from missing historical provider evidence.

preReviewWarnings: Historical direct-main PR absence must remain an explicit limitation.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A1: Re-run current deprecated asset, reference, and documentation context checks against main.
A2: Record whether any current asset is safely deletable; preserve all assets if evidence is incomplete.
A3: Explicitly record that the historical cleanup PR lifecycle cannot be retroactively proven or recreated.
A4: Report active Outcome, then complete a dedicated PR, hosted CI, merge, closure, and cleanup for this audit.
guidelines: Do not infer deletion from a registry row.
Do not claim historical PR evidence that does not exist.

intent.problem: The historical cleanup changed main directly, so its content exists but its required PR/hosted/closure lifecycle is unproven.
constraints: No deletion without new current proof.
Use focused local verification; hosted CI remains mandatory.
intent.rationale: A fresh audit can prove current asset safety and establish a governed lifecycle without fabricating historical provider evidence.

rawUserRequest: Before release clean obsolete code, logic, documentation and completed plans; every Work Item needs instruction-plan-implementation-acceptance traceability and PR lifecycle; continue autonomously.

declaredIntent.summary: Audit current deprecated asset safety and close the missing lifecycle boundary.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Current registry/context checks pass while historical PR absence remains explicitly recorded.
scenarioCoverage.expected: No protected asset is deleted and historical limitation is visible.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run focused deprecated-assets tests and checks, then review archive evidence.

verification.reason: Temporary user authorization permits focused local verification; hosted CI remains required.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: Set only when a human explicitly approves restricted governance paths.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
